2607.10357.title: GRC-ProbNet: Uncertainty-aware Feature Extraction for Cardiovascular Disease Classification
2607.10357.paper_summary: The automatic detection and classification of cardiovascular disease (CVD) from computed tomography (CT) images plays an important role in clinical practice. Recently, a hybrid pipeline (GRC-Net) for CVD classification was proposed, which leverages a deep-learning-based segmentation and registration method to extract radiomic and geometric features. However, GRC-Net relies on a deterministic segmentation mask, without considering the inherent ambiguity associated with cardiac anatomy. In this paper, we propose GRC-ProbNet, which takes advantage of a deep ensemble to produce multiple segmentation masks for a given input. From these masks, we extract multiple uncertainty features. We analyze these uncertainty features for both their correlation with segmentation error and their propagation effects on downstream CVD classification performance. Our experiments on the publicly available MM-WHS and ASOCA datasets show that the uncertainty measure that best reflects segmentation quality is not necessarily the one that provides the strongest signal for downstream CVD classification. Overall, our results demonstrate that GRC-ProbNet utilizing uncertainty features substantially improves CVD classification AUROC (92.92\) compared to the baseline GRC-Net model (91.25%). Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/biomedia-mira/GRC-ProbNet.
2607.10357.paper_summary_zh: 自動檢測和分類心血管疾病（CVD）從計算機斷層掃描（CT）影像中在臨床實踐中扮演著重要角色。最近，提出了一種用於CVD分類的混合管道（GRC-Net），該管道利用基於深度學習的分割和註冊方法來提取放射組學和幾何特徵。然而，GRC-Net依賴於確定性的分割掩碼，未考慮與心臟解剖結構相關的固有模糊性。在本文中，我們提出了GRC-ProbNet，該方法利用深度集成來為給定輸入生成多個分割掩碼。從這些掩碼中，我們提取多個不確定性特徵。我們分析這些不確定性特徵與分割錯誤的相關性以及它們對下游CVD分類性能的傳播效應。我們在公開可用的MM-WHS和ASOCA數據集上的實驗顯示，最佳反映分割質量的不確定性度量不一定是為下游CVD分類提供最強信號的度量。總體而言，我們的結果顯示，利用不確定性特徵的GRC-ProbNet顯著提高了CVD分類的AUROC（92.92%），相比於基線GRC-Net模型（91.25%）。我們的代碼是公開可用的：https://github.com/biomedia-mira/GRC-ProbNet。
